text:
nina: Quick sync outcome from vendor calls: major cloud partner doing a power rebalance next month. Early estimates: 7-13% fewer contiguous H200/H100 blades in affected zones. We need a concrete contingency for marketplace wave sequencing, SI demos and press.
omar: Which regions are in scope? I heard some us-east-1 clusters and a few us-west zones. Need region list to gate properly.
felix: Labs confirm H200 sustained throughput down ~9-11% in stressed racks (long-seq). H100 impact smaller but present on 2U tall racks. MI300 shows mixed behavior; AMD says microcode preview will land Mon.
rachel_marketing: Marketing preference: avoid delaying the consumer-facing landing if mitigations exist. Can we ship availability with "provisional performance" language + clear customer guidance?
talia_legal: Legal: OK to publish provisional profiles but require a correction/caveat clause. If we change public perf claims >5% later, pre-approved correction template + 48h review window required. For press we prefer a 72h buffer.
nvidia_eng: Nvidia note: partner labs observed ~10% sustained derate on some H200 blade configs. We have a microcode candidate that recovers ~5-7% in our internal tests. Partner-preview upload ETA: Wed. Please hold public claims until we validate partner-preview metrics.
amd_eng: AMD: MI300 partner-preview microcode planned Mon afternoon. Some memory configs improve, others show negligible change. We'll include test vectors.
felix: Ops asks: run a derate->tokens/sec sweep and estimate effective slot reduction per region. I can run a script against baseline perf CSVs. Snippet: ```for d in [0.05,0.10,0.15]: adjusted = baseline * (1 - d)``` Will output per-sku estimates.
nina: Proposed immediate plan: (A) Publish availability but mark SKUs "provisional_perf" with tooltip linking partner note; (B) Create region gating CSV that product pulls at publish time; (C) SI dry-run: internal canaries ok, postpone external SI demos 48-72h pending vendor validation; (D) Routing policy: if H200 derate >10% route long-context (>6k tokens) to MI300 if capacity, else B200 with throttles.
omar: I'll create gating CSV template: columns = region, sku, status, expected_fix_date, vendor_note. Example row: `us-east-1,H200,constrained,2026-04-15,"vendor microcode pending"`.
talia_legal: Approve tooltip and partner-note requirement. Marketing's 72h press buffer stands for any public press.
rachel_marketing: We'll prepare a short-banner and press-correction template. Banner draft: "Performance profiles provisional pending vendor firmware updates. See partner note for measured deltas." Legal okay?
talia_legal: Banner language approved. Ensure partner note includes measured delta, test config, and impacted regions.
deploy-bot: perf-sweep job scheduled -> staging-us-east-1 job#12011. Images to test: nvidia/h200:preview (when uploaded), amd/mi300:preview, habana/gaudi:2.7. ETA 6h after images present. Will post CSV link. :white_check_mark:
felix: Action items recap: 1) Ops run derate sweep & produce region-slot-impact CSV (felix). 2) Partnerships draft partner note + partner-only compatibility matrix (nina). 3) Product/Marketplace add sku_flag "provisional_perf" + banner (om ar/product). 4) Legal/Marketing finalize press buffer + correction template (talia/rachel_marketing). 5) Vendors to upload preview images & compat matrices (nvidia_eng/amd_eng). 6) Eng run post-image perf sweeps and post CSVs (deploy-bot/eng).
amd_eng: We'll upload MI300 preview image to s3://partners/mi300/preview and ping this thread when ready.
nvidia_eng: Partner-preview image ETA Wed EOD; will include measured delta table from our internal lab.
nina: Decision tree for press (quick reference): - derate <=5%: proceed public announce with provisional profiles. - derate 5-10%: proceed with provisional profiles; delay press release 72h. - derate >10%: hold press, send partner-only notes, enable routing fallbacks, reassess after vendor patch validation.
omar: I'll codify routing-policy v1 and gating CSV; product can consume that at publish time.
felix: Starting sweep now across baseline fixtures. ETA 5h for initial CSV. I'll upload to /internal/hw-capacity/ with recommended slot adjustments per region.
rachel_marketing: Sales snippet for targeted customers: "We detected a potential small performance variance in reserved H200 capacity in <region>. We can offer migration to MI300 pools or delay your demo while we validate vendor updates. Please reply to this message to opt-in." Need legal review.
talia_legal: Approve sales snippet pending insertion of the specific region and measured delta before send.
nina: We'll reconvene in this thread when the CSVs land or earlier if vendor ETA changes. If vendors confirm fixes >72h out and derate >10% we'll move to a staggered regional announce and notify sales + support to hold press outreach. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
